requirement: v3.2.9: the CI release failed at the End-to-end suites step for v3.2.7 and v3.2.8; a per-file diagnostic workflow identified gpw-auto-approve.test.mjs and a subtest matrix identified the first case (timeout auto-approve + session grant) as the failing one on Linux

assertions.root_cause: v3.2.7 added unref() to the GPW countdown timers; in the CI-controlled event loop an unref timer may finish after the test runner has no other active handles, so the 60 ms auto-approve subtest failed on ubuntu while passing on Windows
assertions.fix: the countdown timers (legacy pending timeout and per-level countdown) are referenced timers again, matching the original implementation; the AI grading semantics, countdown durations and priority invariants are unchanged
assertions.localization: two temporary diagnostic workflows (one step per e2e file, then a matrix over gpw-auto-approve subtests) localized the failure on the public CI: only “approves a yellow call after the timeout and makes its next occurrence blue” failed
assertions.proof: gpw-auto-approve, gpw-ai-priority and gpw-modes all green locally after the fix; the diagnostic workflows are removed from the repository before this release
